mostWorthwhile.text: Raising the potato collar and hilling the bed was the most worthwhile sequence: it connected a practical construction to keeping developing tubers dark.

leastWorthwhile.text: The soybean support was straightforward and offered little discovery, though it made practical sense.

surprise.text: Nothing was particularly surprising; the results followed the visible needs of the beds.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each addressed a stated need for darkness, extra medium, or support.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the crops develop; the practical growing details were engaging, even if these combinations were predictable.
